2. Retrieve pump and wrench from boot (precondition: boot open, hands free).

9. Fasten each hub and tighten nut nuts1–4 with wrench (precondition: wheel on hub, wrench held).
10. Jack down each hub to ground (precondition: hub fastened, jack held).
11. Verify all wheels inflated, mounted on correct hubs, and w1–w4 in boot.
